assertion_analysis.failure_condition: The first guard raises when the stage-by-stage reconstruction's fragment_component or valid differs from the whole topology.read output. It compares two independently computed outputs of the code under test (the split path against the whole path), not a value against the same input the test supplied, so it does redden if a stage is mis-sequenced or a fused path diverges; it is a real guard, but it lives in a prototype script, not a test, so no suite runs it.

The second guard raises when the standalone component-label call's output differs from the read's fragment_component. Same independent-comparison shape as the first and it would redden on a label regression, but again it is only reachable when measure.py is run by hand.

The report is a measurement node's deliverable and adds no assertion over the numbers it publishes (exponents, shares, the 81.315 s total). Nothing reddens if the receipts are regenerated with different numbers and the prose is not updated, so the recorded result is durable only to the extent a reader re-derives it from the receipts.

findings.text: blocking: the landing fragment links its research record as href="/nova/read-warm-wall.html", but the file it points at is docs/research/read-warm-wall.html and the served path is /nova/research/read-warm-wall.html. Every other research-doc link in docs/evidence/fragments/ carries the research/ segment (e.g. docs/evidence/fragments/converged-forward-solve/axis-ranking.html links /nova/research/axis-ranking.html), and this is the only root-level .html link in the whole fragments corpus, so the fragment's single outbound link 404s in the SPA and a reader landing on the evidence fragment cannot reach the report the node exists to produce. Fix by inserting research/ in the href.
